stem: 金融机构(FI)的政策是对每一位新客户都实施强化尽职调查(EDD),以确保该计划的有效性.顾问应如何向该金融机构的管理团队提供建议？

options.A: 建议该金融机构需要对强化尽职调查采取基于风险的方法.
options.B: 建议管理团队选定接受强化尽职调查的客户.
options.C: 建议管理团队就加强尽职调查措施向监管机构寻求建议.
options.D: 建议50%的客户采用EDD是恰当的.

stem_en: A financial institution's (FI's) policy is to apply enhanced due diligence (EDD) for every new client to ensure the effectiveness of the program. How should a consultant advise the FI's management team?

options_en.A: Suggest the FI needs to implement a risk-based approach for EDD
options_en.B: Suggest the management team select the clients that are chosen for EDD
options_en.C: Suggest the management team ask the regulator for advice on EDD measures
options_en.D: Suggest EDD for 50% of the clients is appropriate
